From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>

Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 03 Oct 2028 10:28:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: New vendor onboarding - Sunrise Partners tax docs and PO request

Hi Rebecca —

Thanks for sending the W-9. A quick review flagged a small discrepancy between the EIN on the W-9 (12-3456789) and the EIN shown on the bank letter we typically require for direct deposit verification. Before I kick this to Finance for PO creation we need one of the following: 

- A scanned bank letter (on bank letterhead) that lists the legal entity name and EIN, OR
- A copy of the EIN confirmation letter (CP 575) from the IRS, OR
- A signed, notarized company letter confirming the EIN with a matching bank statement (redact balances).

Also confirm the legal entity name used for tax reporting (exactly as you want it to appear on the PO and the 1099, if applicable). Right now your form lists "Sunrise Partners LLC" but your invoice header I saw earlier says "Sunrise Partners, Inc." — that will block vendor master creation.

If Sunrise is in fact a US entity, W-9 is correct; if you are non-US, we will need a completed W-8BEN-E instead. Can you confirm entity residency?

Next steps once we have verified EIN + exact legal name: we will create vendor master in our ERP and issue a preliminary PO (PO-xxxxxx). Karthik will handle the vendor-master onboarding and Vivek will approve payment terms. I can also send a DocuSign for signatory authorization if you prefer.

DocuSign (optional): https://docusign.com/sunrise-ein-affirmation

Thanks,
Naomi Feldman
Procurement Manager | Redwood Inference
aomi.feldman@redwood.com
